name: Submission creates QR, route snapshot and first awaiting office
Wrong office cannot receive, sign, return, release or detour
Signing and releasing before receipt are rejected
Normal passage through processor, signee, GSO and last office
Completed documents reject further processing and have audit records
Office-submitted document can complete its originating stop at submission
College placeholder resolves to the submitter department office
Ad hoc hold, return and completion credit
Originator history retains skipped original route stop
Normal correction requires release before resubmission and resumes same office
Nested ad hoc detours return in reverse order without duplicate route visits
Cross-account document and office reads are forbidden
Notifications, office ledger, incoming list, KPIs and audit endpoints return data
Resource and administration read endpoints work with the supplied schema
2FA verification cannot create a session without an issued code
